rules.semantic: A knife with no owner at all just dies (no returning blade).

arms.observable: no core:knife_back fx spawned; hook returns false

rules.semantic: A knife thrown by a family with a returning weapon (the soldier) comes back: on death it spawns a knife_back fx owned by the thrower, centred on the knife, on its floor, with its velocity, stepsize and damage, playing the attack animation. Other families' knives just drop. Quirk: a knife whose thrower died is re-owned by itself (family byte 0 == FAMILY_SOLDIER), so an orphaned knife always returns, owned by the dead knife.

arms.observable: exactly one FAMILY_KNIFE_BACK: owner, ani ANI_ATTACK, lastx/lasty/stepsize/damage copied, floor, centred

arms.when: thrower died, owner defaulted to the knife itself (family 0)
arms.observable: knife_back spawned with owner == the knife

missing_arms: thrower died, owner defaulted to the knife itself (family 0)
